check.set.summary: Evaluate a set of checks with scalar/vector/count/Boolean predicates, dependency ordering and distinct outcomes (pass/fail/error/missing/stale/skipped); scalar measurements reuse the existing check engine.

inputs.checks: Nonempty array of check items {id, predicate:{kind, measurement?|actual?, expected?, tolerance?}, dependsOn?:[id], source?, supplierApproval?, externalResult?}.

limitations: Scalar predicates with a measurement reuse the existing check handler; vector/count/Boolean use declared values. An execution error stops dependent sequence and skips downstream items. A source marked ESTIMATED/OPEN is stale, not CONFIRMED.

evidence.package.summary: Build a manifest of declared model/drawing/image/film evidence with completeness, staleness and missing kinds; no files are read or written.

inputs.evidence: Nonempty array of evidence items {id, kind:model|drawing|image|film, path, revision?, source?, supplierApproval?, gate?, hash?}.
inputs.requested: Optional array of kinds to include; defaults to all four kinds.

limitations: The manifest lists declared paths, revisions and gates; no files are read, written or verified.

evidence.check.summary: Check declared evidence for completeness (against required ids/kinds), staleness (ESTIMATED/OPEN source, revision mismatch, missing supplier approval) and missing evidence; missing is unresolved, not a failed test.

inputs.evidence: Nonempty array of evidence items (as evidence.package).
inputs.required: Optional array of required kinds (model/drawing/image/film) and/or evidence ids.

limitations: Completeness is checked against declared ids/kinds; a missing entry is unresolved evidence, not a failed test.

deliver.summary: Acceptance composition: run check.set and evidence checks over a required checklist and compose a manifest; any fail/blocked/unknown returns success false. An empty required checklist is an error.

inputs.checks: Nonempty required checklist (as check.set); an empty array is an error, never acceptance.
inputs.evidence: Optional array of evidence items (as evidence.package).

limitations: deliver composes existing checks and evidence; it does not write duplicate exports or add unrequested formats. Acceptance means the declared checklist and evidence passed; it never certifies the model itself.
